info.schedule: Online, usually a minimum-bid round in July or August and a no-reserve round in the fall
info.note: Catalogs, inspector notes, photos and results come from Title Check's tax-sale.info, which runs the auctions for most Michigan treasurers. County value is twice the State Equalized Value (SEV), since Michigan sets SEV at half of market value.

parcels.desc: Waterfront parcel on Chaney Lake near the Wisconsin border. Old topographical maps suggest there is (or was !) a structure here at one time. There is a trail that leads into this area from a small gap in the guard rail on Chaney Lake Road, however this trail crosses other property and we aren't sure if there is a "legal" access to this property in the chain-of-title. There is no access included in...

100' waterfront parcel in Chaney Lake. 100' x 100' in size according to maps. There is a private shared trail that comes into this parcel from the north which you can identify by the sign "N5782 to 5790" at the road. When you are partially to the lake, you'll notice an overgrown drive that leads to the south (veer right) ... that's the way to this parcel. However when we visited we found that last...

Mid-century bungalow style home on one acre in rural Bessemer Township. Parcel fronts ~104' on the west side of Barber Road and runs ~417' feet deep. ~1 acre. Level, open, dry lands adjacent to pasture. This home comes with appliances; there is a fridge in the back yard and a range out front. Plenty of clutter to remove here, but the home underneath it certainly has potential once cleared. It is d...

This property is a vacant lot measuring ~0.14 acres. This property is located on an unimproved road with unknown access. The plat map is provided in the pictures to show the unimproved Rd Amelia St. Interested bidders should contact the local branch of government regarding possible development and or other use restrictions. E.g. Minimum Sq. footage requirement, utilities, etc.

parcels.address: (Off) N11320 BLACK RIVER RD IRONWOOD MI
parcels.desc: Parcel is roughly 360' square. It does not have any frontage on an improved road. Legal access rights are not clear. You will want to investigate. Fronts on the Black River on the north line, and the Soo Line RR r/o/w bisects the property in the bottom half. Level, wooded uplands.

Older 1.5 story wood frame home and one-half of the garage to the front (shared with neighbor). Cedar shake upper and vinyl sided lower floors. Roof looks really shady with cupped and missing shingle everywhere. There is extensive rot in exterior surfaces including sills and window frame, soffits and the eastern entry door is bowed out several inches. Inside the property is littered wall-to-wall w...

Located across the street and just north of Dutchs Bar. ~11,000 square foot level open lot. ~0.41 acres. Interested bidders should contact the local branch of government regarding possible development and or other use restrictions. E.g. Minimum Sq. footage requirement, utilities, etc.

Vacant parcel fronts on both Main Street (west) and Hall Street (east) We sold the house to the north of this in the last year or two and we wonder if the septic system for that house isn't on THIS parcel. ~0.41 acres. Interested bidders should contact the local branch of government regarding possible development and or other use restrictions. E.g. Minimum Sq. footage requirement, utilities, etc.

Parcel is a few miles east of Wakefield, on the north side of US 2. Sits about ten feet above road grade on the north side of the road. 400' more or less on the highway.. Gently rolling wooded property. We did not see any trails or drives into this parcel, but there is one on the property to the east that accesses the powerline easement and there is a collapsed camper and abandoned vehicle here .....

Approximately 2-acre property with a collapsing cabin. The structure is in very poor condition, with visible roof failure and significant exterior deterioration. The interior was not inspected, and its condition is unknown but is presumed to be poor. Significant portions of the land are indicated to be wet per GIS mapping. Buyers should perform their own due diligence and thoroughly research the p...

Sale includes two parcels, so you'll get two tax bills :). Mid century ranch on a double corner lot on the south side of Bessemer. Two very dead trees in the front need to go. Side lot contains a two car detached garage full of debris, and a couple of small piles near that garage also. The house has a three car attached garage that is also LOADED to the degree that you car barely see the Crown Vic...

The value here is in the land and infrastructure.  Triangular parcel of land on the east side of Osmose Road near the old Tilden Mine location. Old mobile here that has burned. Not a rational candidate for repair, but it still has the tongue and hitch to make removal a little easier !~0.30 acres, with most of the land to the south (right side) of the trailer. Interested bidders should contact the ...

This is a pretty solid older two story wood frame home near downtown Ironwood. We found heaved floors on the main and upper levels, but no apparent roof leaks which is an indicator of frozen plumbing. We see deflection in the foundation wall on the north/left side. 2 BR 1 BA up, 1/2 BA down. This is a pretty solid place that could be okay with a little work. Some curled and cupped roof shingle nea...

1.5 story wood frame home in Ironwood. Porches are sagging and there is rotten structural repair work to do in numerous spots on the exterior. Steel roof was not done well, and it looks like the ice and wind has played havoc with it in places. Inside the home has the original (painted) trim remaining, and is of the 4-square design on the main floor. 4 BR 1 BA up. Some leaded glass windows and hard...

Wood frame home wrapped in Asphalt shingle siding and a steel roof. Some upgraded thermal pane windows showing signs of decay from lack of maintenance. At the end of a cul-de-sac at the very bottom end of Ironwood City. Large storage/shop building has two large overhead doors. House has collapsing foundation walls on the west side. Inside, we noticed an RV model chemical toilet in use, which infer...

High visibility corner parcel at Sunday Lake and Nunnemacher Streets in Wakefield. Irregular in shape ... about 1/4 acre ! Interested bidders should contact the local branch of government regarding possible development and or other use restrictions. E.g. Minimum Sq. footage requirement, utilities, etc.

This is a property that was LOOOOAAADED with debris. The City of Wakefield has cleaned up the majority of the mess, and now the property is available for repurposing. There is still some minor debris here to clean up, but for the most part the surface is cleared. We do see some junk to the rear which may or may not be on these parcels ... photos just for reference.  There may be some debris buried...

Parcel is about 8800 square feet. Located on the north side of North Street at Plymouth location. Densely wooded on a paved county road. Interested bidders should contact the local branch of government regarding possible development and or other use restrictions. E.g. Minimum Sq. footage requirement, utilities, etc.

Parcel measures 330' (e>w) x 1320' (n>s). It is almost entirely marshlands. The only parts that is somewhat firm is at the small point where it actually touches Old US2 (Charles Street) and that part is probably within the r/o/w and can't be improved. So whatcha got here is a frog farm. A cat-tail ranch. A lillipad lounge. Interested bidders should contact the local branch of government regarding ...

The property is ~0.14 acres with no known legal access. If planning to develop the land please contact the local government unit to get more information on possible building restrictions. E.g. Minimum Sq. footage requirement.

This one is on the verge of final collapse. It is open to the sky and you can see daylight creeping out from underneath boarded doors and windows. It won't be long until this and the old Jessieville fire station building are both just piles of rubble.  There is no saving this one.

This house has deferred maintenance and needs a new roof. We weren't able to gain entry to view the interior as it was well secured. Appears to have a wood-burning fireplace. The yard is very overgrown, and it clearly has not been taken care of in at least 5 years or more.

Was originally a duplex, but has been combined. Interior is mostly gutted, and someone began some rehabbing and then quit. Foundation issues. Someone started rehabbing the garage into living or shop space also, though no plumbing out there. Needs a roof. We would consider this a shell, and start from scratch after gutting and reroofing it IF the foundation can be addressed in the area where it is ...

This one started life as a duplex, and was later converted into a single family unit. Side porch to the west is collapsing and detaching from the structure. Older shingle roof near the end of life. It has had some upgrades to windows, but there are also others in dire need of replacement. Large front picture window has bad seal and is clouded. Wood siding is old and weatherbeaten. Someone remodele...

The property is ~0.14 acres with no known legal access. If planning to develop the land please contact the local government unit to get more information on possible building restrictions. E.g. Minimum Sq. footage requirement.

Sales 2405 and 2406 are two adjacent 20 acre parcels in Erwin Township on the McDonald Dam Road. Buy one or both and have a square 40 ! These are "standing up" 20's ... that measure 660' feet east>west x 1320' north>south. The county road crosses these parcels near the north boundary, but there is a small slice of land to the north and the majority of the parcel lies to the south side of the road....

Sales 2405 and 2406 are two adjacent 20 acre parcels in Erwin Township on the McDonald Dam Road. Buy one or both and have a square 40 ! These are "standing up" 20's ... that measure 660' feet east>west x 1320' north>south. The county road crosses these parcels near the north boundary, but there is a small slice of land to the north and the majority of the parcel lies to the south side of the road....

Older enclosed, roof over mobile home and frame addition in Marenisco. Address is 231 Main Street, but it faces Hall Street instead. The interior has been gutted down to studs and converted into a primitive grow house. No kitchen, bath or functioning heat. Cannibalized. Could be put back together with some work. Small outbuilding.

Property is apparently still under the control of the former owner. Older one story wood frame house in Marenisco. Big privacy screen around yard and warning signs could indicate a grow operation. Camper in yard. Older roof. Under video surveillance !!

Collapsing house and garage in Marenisco. Full of garbage and left to rot. House has been condemned by the local building official and cannot be legally occupied until it is completely brought to code. COUGH. Someone invested in a new electric service here not long ago .... property is overgrown and its difficult to assess condition.

This stretch of "Old" US-45 is primitive. After leaving US-45 and driving one mile up this trail, we didn't see anything but trees. No side trails .. no power .. no structures .. no anything. Parcel is 154' x 285, and may have access issues depending on exactly where the r/o/w of the road is. Real nice, quiet secluded setting

We believe this one was still occupied at the time of our visit in early June.  Small vinyl-sided wood construction. The roof shows indicators of being a leaker and will need replacement. This is a small home and we can't imagine it having more than two bedrooms on the main floor, if that. Brick-faced foundation seems in decent repair. Could not get any interior view because of the occupancy. No s...

Older wood frame home that has been tastefully updated. Vinyl siding and a rood that is mid-life. This was occupied at the time of our inspection in early June, so we could not review it in detail. Appears to be cluttered but generally in good repair. on a quiet side street, just a mile or so from the LacVue Desert Resort and Casino.

1.5 story home in Bessemer. Vinyl sided for low maintenance. Has a newer steel roof. Some decay is evident where the garage meets the house wall. This place is hoarded, and is loaded with mostly clothing and the non-stinky variety of debris. Accumulation everywhere you look, both inside and out. Until you get this emptied out, you won't really be able to determine conditions. We think this has a w...
Let the pictures tell the story.

You'll notice that a house has recently been removed from the lot to the west of this parcel. That lot is *not* part of this sale ... this is the spot where the garage (marked "308") sits and the vacant lot in front of the garage. A house has been removed here also ... the 2 car detached garage remains. The garage is in merchantable condition ... the typical 24'x 24' garage. On busy US 2 in Bessem...

Someone has kinda, sorta remodeled ... or started to ... some of this one. But other parts are authentic, old and shady. The interior is simply, old. This house (before the "remodel" started) was probably untouched for years. It has been stripped of most of its original trim and features. It is basically a solid shell from which to start over. Will need a roof, and everything under it, too. No fur...

OCCUPIED modern singlewide mobile home on a crawlspace. Attached 2.5 car garage and workshop space. This property appears to be in good overall condition but was OCCUPIED when we visited in early June. Beware of dog sign at door.

Cedar shake siding. Fairly new roof. Cheery, inviting glass-enclosed front porch. Does seem to be some settling and separation in the porch. Inside, the house is cluttered with rummage sale grade stuff and almost appears to have been used more for storage than living. Three bedrooms and a mid-century pink bath upstairs. The basement floor is heaved. Older 60A electrical, fairly modern natural gas ...

This could be a really great property in the right hands. Right now it is EXTREMELY grubby and covered from end to end in dog poo and hair. It appears that a dog may have been left here for extended periods without the ability to go outside. We don't need to explain further, do we ? That smell permeates the whole house. If you get that cleaned up, and get this place resurfaced, this could be a cha...
40' wide (at road) vacant lot. Toward the southern edge of the downtown district. Irregular in shape, has a chunk cut out for a neighboring parcel at the rear ... not an encroachment.

This is a frequent flyer and has been in the sale before.  The roof has collapsed into the building. This is infill-type construction, and the building has no side walls on the second floor ... it is simply built between the side walls of the two adjacent buildings. This one is beyond any rational concept of restoration from both a physical and economic vantage.

This one has been sitting for quite some time. There are a couple of localized roof leaks that are severe. It is overgrown and full of pigeons. We have sold this one before ... it's actually quite an impressive old church ... but it has just been decaying since then. It was occupied about 15 years ago we are told. There are several broken windows and the inside is both soaked/damp AND full of pige...
This is a sale of two adjoining parcels that contain a total of three platted lots on Mansfield Street in Ironwood. Open, level parcel.

The home has a newer-looking roof. One story, lower grade housing on a wood pier footing system ... so there is some sway in floors. This is a pretty tiny place ... maybe about 25' x 25' in size. So small that you can heat it with a flashlight! The vacant parcel is to the right/south side of the house. This could probably be saved with some effort, but will need a resurfacing of interior surfaces ...

Home is in need of a foundation. We sold this a few years ago, and whoever bought it got well underway with drywall and upgrades, and then walked away. There are issues all around this one with the foundation ... some of which has been replaced with wood elements that are failing. It really should be raised and a new foundation poured underneath if you're serious about this property. Windows are l...

This one is on the verge of final collapse. It is open to the sky and you can see daylight creeping out from underneath boarded doors and windows. It won't be long until this and the old Jessieville fire station building are both just piles of rubble.  There is no saving this one.
Small pile of what's left of an old shed/garage toward the rear of the parcel. At the southern edge of Ironwood
There was a home here that was removed this spring. It's now a nice clean fresh level lot. A great yard addition for a neighbor ... SCORE !!

Large, ancient, SOLID old wood timber barn. Two floors. Roughly 3000 sft/floor. This appears to have been used as a "grow" facility, as it is wired to the teeth. Most of that has been removed, but it's clear what was happening here. There is a small spartan penthouse apartment up on the second floor. Right now it is open to the elements and has numerous missing windows and the overhead front door ...

This one may need demo. Bad roof. Has been animal damaged by dozens of cats. Lots of issues on the inside that you won't fix with a can of Lysol and a mop. This property is still occupied, so we could not view it in detail, but is is of legend in the neighborhood. Infested with mice. Visible vandalism and lack of maintenance

Even Mother Theresa may not be able to save this one. Numerous large holes in the roof. The roof on this house has been leaking for YEARS and it is loaded with rot along the eaves and fascia. Someone made a valiant effort to start a re-roof here, and then walked away. The inside has a lot of water damage, but is in much better shape than the outside would suggest. Is it worth taking on? That's you...
Double vacant lot. Ironwood. ~0.48 acres

Fairly solid and cute little house in Wakefield. Clean. Has been harvested of most of its fixtures, including the furnace, service panel, plumbing fixtures, and the front door. Has some bad spots in the foundation at the front two corners. On a crawlspace. The older roof needs a refresh, but it wasn't leaking to the inside. With some attention, this could be a cute place.

Former owner lives next door. This is a small rustic cabin that has visible signs of settling. There is a substantial failure in the structure at the front corner where the front porch meets the main structure. Older roof. Not likely to warrant much investment, but that's your call.

Vacant lot measures ~0.77 acres. On our last visit which was in July of 2024 this vacant lot was filled with junk cars and trailers. This junk is considered personal property and is not included as part of this sale. If planning to develop the land please contact the local government unit to get more information on possible building restrictions. E.g. Minimum Sq. footage requirement.

Older 1.5 story home east of Plymouth location. This one has not been maintained in years and has a bad roof, and extensive rot to soffit, eaves and fascia. The interior is cluttered and dated. Two parcels in this sale, on the opposite sides of Plymouth Road. Foundation is heading into the basement in a few spots.

Parcel is roughly 1/2 acre in size.  Level, low lands at road grade in Wakefield. Paved street with sidewalk, Municipal water and natural gas are available here. Check with the zoning folks as to your intended use.

The subject property is a vacant 2.1-acre parcel that are surrounded by 2 private landowners. The parcel is located on the east side of W Duck Lake Road south of the Forest Service Road 6323 intersection about 5 miles southwest of Watersmeet MI. The property has approximately 100 feet of frontage on Duck Lake which is the eastern property line. The subject property is 933-foot (east-west) X 100-fo...
